exposure: preterm premature rupture of the membranes (PPROM)
outcome: cesarean delivery due to fetal distress or chorioamnionitis
cohort: 295 women with preterm premature rupture of the membranes (PPROM)
finding: The presence of histological chorioamnionitis (HCA) in women with PPROM was associated with shorter latency period, worse neonatal outcomes, and higher rates of adverse maternal and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: The group with histological chorioamnionitis in the context of preterm premature rupture of membranes had a higher rate of cesarean delivery due to fetal distress or chorioamnionitis.
